layout.house_prompt: This is a modern bedroom with a spa-like bathroom. The bedroom has a queen-size bed with vibrant pillows. A sleek dresser sits against one wall, adorned with a small jewelry box and a decorative mirror. A reading corner includes an armchair and a small side table. Adjacent to the bedroom, the bathroom features a large bathtub next to a frosted window. A vanity opposite the tub holds two sinks with skincare products.

bedroom.text_description: A modern primary bedroom with a queen-size bed dressed with vibrant pillows, a sleek dresser against one wall topped with a small jewelry box and a decorative mirror, and a reading corner with an armchair and a small side table.

bathroom.text_description: A modern spa-like bathroom adjacent to the bedroom featuring a large bathtub placed next to a frosted privacy window and a vanity opposite the tub with two sinks and skincare products.
